data.long_meaning: Awraaq means 'little green one' in Arabic. This name is derived from the word 'awraq' which means 'green' in Arabic. It is a beautiful name for a baby who is born during spring or for someone who loves nature and all its vibrant colors. The name Awraaq carries the meaning “Little Green One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awraaq usually hope their child will grow to embody little green one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
